title: Beavers Nearly Vanished, Then Saved The Ecosystem
hook: You erased 100 million beavers -- only 100,000 made it out.
closing: Turns out the 'pest' flooding your yard might be a firefighter.
question: Seen a real beaver dam up close?

segments.say: Beavers have rebounded to about 12 million today, after fur trappers nearly wiped them out.
A peer-reviewed study found streams without beaver dams burned 3 times worse in wildfires than streams with them.
A single beaver dam can hold 1.1 million gallons of water, more than an Olympic swimming pool.
